{{Top|leg}}
'''Dune Sea Sabacc''' was a version of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] popular to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Apart from [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], nobody else seemed to understand the rules. With no witnesses to the contrary, Jawa [[R'kik D'nec]] was the undefeated champion of the game.
